name: Tomato Chickpea Salad
description: A refreshing salad featuring chickpeas, diced tomatoes, cucumber, and crumbled feta, all tossed in a tangy herb-infused dressing.
recipeIngredient: 1 (28 oz) can chickpeas, rinsed and drained
Dressing: 1/3 cup olive oil, 3 Tbsp white wine vinegar, 1 crushed garlic clove, 1 tsp dried tarragon leaves, 1/2 tsp dry mustard, 1/4 tsp pepper, pinch cayenne pepper

recipeInstructions.text: In a large bowl, combine chickpeas, diced tomatoes, cucumber, green onions, and parsley.
In a small bowl, whisk together the dressing ingredients: olive oil, vinegar, garlic, tarragon, mustard, pepper, and cayenne.
Toss the dressing with the salad ingredients until well coated.
Cover and refrigerate for several hours before serving.

keywords: chickpea salad, tomato salad, Mediterranean salad, feta cheese

_similar.name: Pasta Salad
_similar.description: A colorful pasta salad with penne or spiral pasta, vegetables, feta cheese, and a tangy herb dressing.
recipeIngredient: ½ bag penne or spiral pasta

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the pasta according to package instructions, then drain and cool.
Add chopped green pepper, tomatoes, green onions, and sliced black olives to the cooled pasta.
Crumble the feta cheese into the pasta mixture.
Pour the Classic Herb dressing over the salad and toss to combine.

_similar.name: Veggie Basic Soup
_similar.description: A hearty vegetable soup made with a variety of vegetables and flavorful broth.

recipeInstructions.text: In a large pot, melt butter over medium heat. Cook onions, carrots, and celery until the onion is translucent.
Stir in tomatoes, beef broth, soya sauce, Worcestershire sauce, parsley, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes or until the vegetables are tender and flavors are well blended.

_similar.keywords: vegetable soup, beef broth, savory soup

_similar.name: Caribbean Chicken Salad
_similar.description: A refreshing salad featuring chicken, mango, pineapple, and Minute Rice, all tossed in Italian dressing.
recipeIngredient: 1 small can pineapple, diced and drained

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the Minute Rice in chicken broth according to package instructions.
Cook the chicken breast meat in a little oil until fully cooked.
Combine the cooked rice, chicken, and remaining ingredients in a large bowl.
Chill until served. Optional: add other fruits like grapes, mandarins, or plums for variation.

_similar.keywords: Caribbean chicken salad, fruit and rice salad, Italian dressing

_similar.name: Nacho Salad
_similar.description: A spicy nacho salad with ground beef, lettuce, tomatoes, and nacho chips, topped with a creamy dressing.
recipeIngredient: 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese (or mozzarella), shredded

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef with onion and garlic. Drain excess fat.
Add spices and water to the beef mixture. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 15 minutes. Let cool for 10 minutes.
In a large salad bowl, mix together the shredded lettuce, diced tomatoes, shredded cheese, and crushed nacho chips.
In a separate bowl, mix the mayonnaise, relish, ketchup, and hot pepper sauce.
Pour the dressing over the salad and add the cooled meat mixture.
Toss the salad to combine all ingredients and serve.

_similar.keywords: nacho salad, spicy salad, ground beef salad

_similar.name: Chili Con Carne
_similar.description: A hearty and versatile chili recipe featuring ground beef, kidney beans, and a variety of vegetables, ideal for customization.
recipeIngredient: Optional: additional vegetables like zucchini, carrots, mushrooms

recipeInstructions.text: In a large nonstick skillet, cook ground beef over medium-high heat until browned and crumbly; drain off excess fat.
Add onion and garlic to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes.
Add cabbage, celery, green pepper, tomatoes with juice, tomato sauce, kidney beans, chili powder, oregano, salt, and hot pepper sauce to the skillet.
Optionally add other desired vegetables (e.g., zucchini, carrots, mushrooms) at this stage.
Cover and simmer over medium heat for 45 minutes, or until vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally.

_similar.keywords: chili con carne, ground beef chili, customizable chili
